purpose: Teach: 倭/弌/丙/鉉/辺野古/住専/フジサンケイビジネスアイ/日本経済新聞社
target_vocab: フジサンケイビジネスアイ

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、古代倭、つまり倭国時代の遺物盗難を、警察、捜査されますね
lines.en: So the police are investigating the theft of artifacts from ancient Wa — that is, from the Wa Kingdom period.
lines.style: Measured, methodical tone. Speaking as if walking through a formal checklist. Slight pause before each clarification. Respectful distance maintained.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、旧字「弌」、つまり一の刻まれた古印鑑も鑑定されますね
lines.en: And the police are having the old seal authenticated — the one with the character for 'one' carved in the archaic script.
lines.style: Calm, collaborative. Confirming each point with steady agreement. The rhythm of someone following along carefully, not rushing. Voice level and sure.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、丙、つまり丙号書類の機密管理を、警察、確認されますね
lines.en: So the police are verifying the confidentiality protocols for the Class C documents in this case.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Careful precision on the classification level. Slight dip in volume, like checking something off mentally. Almost to himself.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、骨董の鉉、つまり鉉の鼎の盗難捜査もされますね
lines.en: And the police are also handling the investigation into the theft of the antique bronze tripod.
lines.style: Affirmative nod in the voice. Steady, accepting the scope of the work without hesitation. Brief pause before the object name, showing respect for the artifact.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、辺野古地域の事案を、警察、地元署と連携されますね
lines.en: So in this case, the police are coordinating with the local precinct regarding the Henoko area situation.
lines.style: Careful enunciation of the place name. Reflective, as if considering the geographical and jurisdictional implications. Even pace, a touch of formality.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、住専、つまり住宅金融の詐欺事案も対応されますね
lines.en: And the police are also handling the housing finance fraud cases — the Jusen-related matters.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact acknowledgment. No strain in the voice, just adding another item to the understood list. Competent and clear.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、フジサンケイビジネスアイの取材対応を、警察、される事ありますね
lines.en: In this case, the police do handle media inquiries — like from Fuji Sankei Business i.
lines.style: Slight upward lilt, like a question formed as a statement. Testing understanding. A touch of curiosity about operational protocols.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、日本経済新聞社からの照会にも、警察、丁寧に対応されますね
lines.en: And the police respond carefully to inquiries from the Nikkei, as well.
lines.style: Warm confirmation. Final nod of understanding. Gentle settling into agreement. The pace softens slightly, signaling closure of the topic.
